signature.one_line: One-take listicle: chest captions with hopping black word box, boxed hook title, stacking list pills.
unique_devices: Karaoke box highlight on the chest: whole 2-line chunk appears at once, the word being spoken sits in a hard-jumping black rounded box
Hook sentence as a merged per-line black-box title with the one viewer word in CAPS, plus a white 'save this' sticker pill that hard-cuts in under it ~31 frames in
Numbered black list pills that hard-cut in as each item is named, stacking 2-3 deep; the second stack restarts smaller and higher; captions hidden during the list
signature.why_it_works: A surprising incentive plus a save prompt land within the first ~10 % of runtime; text changes every 30-60 frames so a single static take holds at ~180 wpm.

hook.first_frame: Static medium close-up of the speaker against a soft beige backdrop with a plant; a 2-line white-on-black hook title across the chest from frame 0

structure.what: Black-box hook title with the viewer word in caps; save sticker pops under it
Promise of a top-N list that gets the viewer results
N items named rapidly as numbered black pills stacking under each other
Why the items work (insider access, unadvertised opportunities)
Comment-a-keyword for the links, then a follow ask

pacing.pace: single take (no cuts), text changing every 30-60 frames

captions.how: Poppins 700 55 px white, 1-4 words over 2 short lines centred at x ~48 %, line 1 ink 66.7-69.6 % H, line 2 70.2-73.1 % H; chunk hard-cuts in ~2 frames after its first word; black rounded box (radius 6 px, ~3.67 % H tall) hops to each spoken word

background_text.how: Hook sentence in 2 centred lines, Poppins 700 57 px white on merged black per-line boxes (rounded ~6 px) spanning x 11.9-81.2 %, y 61.6-70.4 %; viewer word in CAPS; ends with '..'; static, hard cut out
White rounded pill (radius ~9 px) x 17.9-70.7 %, y 71.1-76.5 %, 0.7 % H under the title; black Poppins 700 56 px 3-word save prompt + green check emoji; hard cut in/out, no pop

cards_lists.how: Black rounded pills (radius ~6 px) with white left-aligned 'N. Item' text; each hard-cuts in under the previous ~2 frames after the item is named. Stack 1 (items 1-3): 53 px text, pills 5.1 % H, left edge x 23.4 %, rows 64.7-69.8 % and 71.1-76.2 %. Stack 2 (items 4-6): 40 px text, pills 3.7 % H, left edge x 33.1 %, row tops 61.6 / 66.0 / 71.2 %

layout.what: Static MCU, text on the chest
layout.how: Eyes at ~28 % H, chin ~57 %; all text between 61 and 77 % H

camera.how: No cuts, no punch-ins; motion only from hand gestures

case.normal: sentence case as transcribed (capital at sentence starts and 'I'); contractions may be expanded

captions_spec.punctuation: sentence-final full stops kept; commas dropped

grouping.sync: the whole 2-line chunk appears at once ~2 frames after its first word; the black box hops word by word
grouping.break: new chunk every 2-4 words, hard cut; a sentence-final word often gets its own 1-word chunk

layout.align: centre, line centres at x ~48 % of W
layout.line_gap: tight (~0.6 % H between ink boxes; the active box of line 2 touches line 1's descenders)
layout.face_clearance: below the chin (~57 %), on the chest

normal.font_class: geometric sans, bold (single-storey g with open tail, round o, straight-leg y)

active.font_class: same font and size; only the box is added

box.example: a 10-letter word's box spans x 31.9-63.8 %, y 69.6-73.2 %

animation.chunk_entry: hard cut, whole chunk at once, ~2 frames after its first spoken word
animation.highlight_move: black box hard-jumps to the next word +2 to +5 frames after its start in the source (aim for 0-2); no box during short gaps between words
animation.exit: hard cut on the next chunk

other_text_spec.when: 0-9.5 % of runtime (replaced by normal captions after)
other_text_spec.copy: hook sentence, sentence case, the one viewer word in CAPS, ends with a double full stop (placeholder 'Headline here that only / works if YOU act..')
other_text_spec.box: #000000 behind each line, merged into one shape with rounded corners (~6 px @1920), spanning x 11.9-81.2 %, y 61.6-70.4 %
other_text_spec.animation: on from frame 0, static, hard cut out (~83 frames)

other_text_spec.when: 3.6-8.4 % of runtime (in at frame ~31, out at frame ~73)
other_text_spec.copy: 3-word save prompt + green check emoji (placeholder 'Save these now <check>')
other_text_spec.animation: hard cut in (full size on its first frame, no pop), hard cut out

other_text_spec.copy: 'N. Item name' (number + full stop + name, Title case), 6 items
other_text_spec.animation: each pill hard-cuts in under the previous one ~2 frames after its item is spoken; the stack resets when item 4 starts a new, smaller stack higher up

style.look_intent: low-contrast, saturated, warm: soft indoor light, beige backdrop with green plant, natural warm skin

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected; speech covers 100 %)
sfx: optional: soft pop on each list pill

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user has one static talking-head take that names a list of resources, tools or companies
the content is a 'top N' or 'save this list' listicle with a comment-keyword CTA
delivery is fast and continuous (~170-190 wpm, few pauses)
the chest area below the chin is clean enough for text
avoid_when: the take is long with no cuts and the delivery has pauses (add punch-ins every 90-120 frames)
the brand wants a premium/editorial caption look rather than social-native pills
the speaker's chest area is busy or the shot is a tight close-up
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B48 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B48.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. Static single-take talking head; all visual change is text on the chest (61-77 % H).

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} on {{ACCENT}} boxes >= 7:1, {{ACCENT}} boxes >= 3:1 against the clothing, {{ACCENT}} text on {{CARD_BG}} >= 7:1)
- {{TEXT}}: caption and pill text, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: active-word box, hook-title boxes, list pills, save-pill text, default #000000
- {{ACCENT_2}}: unused, default none
- {{SURFACE}}: unused, default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: save sticker pill fill, default #FFFFFF
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Poppins 700
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Poppins 700
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source; optional in the follow ask
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source

CAPTIONS
1. As spoken, sentence case; keep sentence-final full stops, drop commas.
2. Chunks of 1-4 words over 2 short lines (1-2 on line 1, 1-3 on line 2); a sentence-final word may stand alone ("KEY WORD."). Whole chunk hard-cuts in ~2 frames after its first word.
3. {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 55 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke/shadow. Calibration: "connection" ink 2.27 % H / 29.3 % W; "recruitment" 2.27 % / 31.9 %.
4. Active word: sits in a {{ACCENT}} box, radius 6 px, padding 13 px left/right, 12 px top, 15 px bottom (~3.67 % H tall); text stays {{TEXT}}, same size. The box hard-jumps to each word on its start (0-2 frames); no box during short gaps.
5. Position: lines centred at x ~48 % W; line 1 ink 66.7-69.6 % H, line 2 70.2-73.1 % H (block centre ~70 %), tight line gap, below the chin.
6. Hard cuts only: no fade, pop, scale or idle motion.

OTHER TEXT
7. Hook title (frames 0-~83, replaces captions): hook sentence in 2 centred lines (x ~46 %), {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 57 px {{TEXT}} on merged {{ACCENT}} per-line boxes (~6 px rounded corners) spanning x 11.9-81.2 %, y 61.6-70.4 %; the one viewer word in CAPS; end with "..". Line ink ~2.97 % H; a ~24-character line spans ~63.5 % W.
8. Save sticker (frames ~31-73): {{CARD_BG}} rounded pill (radius ~9 px) x 17.9-70.7 %, y 71.1-76.5 %, 0.7 % H under the title; {{ACCENT}} {{FONT_BODY}} 56 px 3-word save prompt + green check emoji, left-aligned from x 20.1 %. Hard cut in/out, no pop.
9. List items (replace captions while items are named, ~29-48 % of runtime): {{ACCENT}} pills, radius ~6 px, {{TEXT}} {{FONT_BODY}} "N. Item", left-aligned, each hard-cut in under the previous ~2 frames after its item is spoken. Stack 1 (items 1-3): 53 px text, pills 5.1 % H, left edge x 23.4 %, rows 64.7-69.8 % and 71.1-76.2 %. Stack 2 (items 4-6): 40 px text, pills 3.7 % H, left edge x 33.1 %, row tops 61.6 / 66.0 / 71.2 %.

STRUCTURE: hook ~10 %, setup ~17 %, list ~21 %, why/proof ~24 %, comment-keyword CTA then follow ask ~28 %.
SOUND: voice only, no bed. Master to about -14.5 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: low-contrast, saturated, warm soft indoor light, natural skin.

VERIFY before rendering: render the calibration words and measure them:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_connection> --box 0.2,0.700,0.8,0.728 --ink "#FFFFFF:60"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_recruitment> --box 0.2,0.700,0.8,0.733 --ink "#FFFFFF:60"
"connection" must read ink 2.27 % +-0.5 of H and width 29.3 % +-2 of W; "recruitment" 2.27 % +-0.5 / 31.9 % +-2; the active box measured with --ink "#000000:25" over --box 0.2,0.64,0.8,0.75 must be 3.67 % +-0.5 tall. Swap --ink colours to {{TEXT}} / {{ACCENT}}. Expected ink for other words: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py with {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 55 px. Positions within +-1 % of frame height.
